business_model.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1 Business, period 2025-12-31)
business_model.claim: Nabors makes money primarily by owning and operating drilling rigs for land-based and offshore oil and gas wells, billing customers under daywork contracts that pay a basic rate per day when drilling.
quotes: Nabors owns and operates one of the world's largest land-based drilling rig fleets and is a provider of offshore platform rigs in the United States and numerous international markets.

Our drilling contracts are typically daywork contracts. A daywork contract generally provides for a basic rate per day when drilling (the dayrate for providing a rig and crew) and for lower rates when the rig is moving between drilling locations, or when drilling operations are interrupted or restricted by equipment breakdowns, adverse weather conditions or other conditions beyond our control.
